protocol: Preparation of LB Agar (250 mL bottles)
samples_in: LB agar powder; house DI water
samples_out: 1 x 250 mL bottle sterile molten LB agar
notes: Pressure cooker 20 min high pressure then natural release. Cooker afterwards holds ~55 C as the pouring bath.

samples_in: 2YT powder; house DI water
notes: NO PROTOCOL EXISTS. Same cooker run as agar_fresh; the small cooker holds five 250 mL bottles and agar_fresh takes one.

samples_in: carbenicillin powder ~50 mg; mol-bio grade water
notes: volume uL = mass mg x 10

samples_in: spectinomycin powder ~50 mg; mol-bio grade water
notes: Arithmetic identical to carb (x 10). Not poured into plates this shoot; prepared only.

samples_in: kanamycin powder ~25 mg; mol-bio grade water
notes: volume uL = mass mg x 40. Protect from light. Scoop ~25 mg not 50 or it will not fit a 1.5 mL tube.

samples_in: erythromycin powder; solvent TBC
notes: NOT IN THE MODULE - renders with [set factor] placeholders and defaults the solvent to water. Needs a concentration and a solvent.

samples_in: 1 solidified 250 mL LB agar bottle off the shelf
notes: Separate protocol and separate video from agar_fresh. Microwave; loosen lid a quarter turn; 30-60 s bursts.

samples_in: 125 mL molten agar at ~55 C; 125 uL abx_carb
notes: Red stripes on the side; "Carb" on the bottom.

samples_in: 125 mL molten agar at ~55 C; 125 uL abx_erm
notes: No stripe convention exists for erythromycin - one has to be picked on camera.

samples_in: 125 mL molten agar at ~55 C; 125 uL abx_kan
notes: Green stripes; "Kan" on the bottom.

samples_in: 125 mL molten agar at ~55 C; no additive
notes: The no-drug plate. Nothing selects here - it is what proves the others do.

samples_in: 3 control glycerol stocks; one plate each of pour_carb pour_erm pour_kan pour_lb
samples_out: 4 plates sectored in three; one strain per sector
notes: NO PROTOCOL EXISTS. This is the 3x4 matrix. 37 C inverted overnight.

samples_in: nothing
samples_out: 4 uninoculated plates - one of each type
notes: Incubated empty. Tests the pour and the hood; a different failure from anything the matrix catches.

samples_in: 1 x 100 uL competent cell aliquot; 3 control plasmids; 1 no-DNA blank
samples_out: 4 reactions sitting on the 4 C block; 4 labelled plates
notes: SHOOT 1 OF 2 - thaw cells; add DNA; label plates. Ends at the 10 min 4 C hold.

samples_in: the 4 reactions from ctrl_transform
notes: SHOOT 2 OF 2 - 90 s at 42 C then plate. Carb takes the direct branch; kan and erm take the rescue branch (200 uL 2YT; 37 C; 1 h).

samples_in: spare poured plates
notes: Stable 1-2 weeks. Never parafilm anything going into the incubator.

samples_in: every plate from day 1
notes: DAY 2. NO PROTOCOL EXISTS. Needs somebody with weekend access; it is not a session.
No protocol. RPU; J23101 = 1 RPU; pJ12 weak; pJ01 the reference; pJ19 strong; same backbone same reporter.

samples_out: 7 reactions on the 4 C block; 7 labelled carb plates
notes: SHOOT 1 OF 2 - thaw; add DNA; label plates. 16 uL cells + KCM + 0.5 uL DNA per reaction; all seven off one aliquot.

samples_in: 7 carb plates grown overnight
samples_out: 24-well block; 4 mL 2YT + carb per well; airpore sheet
notes: NO PROTOCOL EXISTS. 7 plasmids x 4 colonies = 28 wells into a 24-well block. Does not fit as written on bestp.md. Pick left-to-right to match the data entry layout.

samples_out: black-walled Tecan plate; 100 uL per culture; 2 technical replicates
